mapper.select: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS `tableName`, TABLE_COMMENT AS `tableComment` FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = (SELECT DATABASE()) AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE 'sys\_%' AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE 'tb\_%' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS `columnName`, COLUMN_COMMENT AS `columnComment`, DATA_TYPE AS `dataType`, IS_NULLABLE AS `isNullable`, COLUMN_KEY AS `columnKey`, ORDINAL_POSITION AS `ordinalPosition` FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = (SELECT DATABASE()) AND TABLE_NAME = #{tableName} ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
